contract.authority: User: continue improving weight-space programming; no game adaptation; no gradient parameter updates.
contract.construction: New separately written analytic initial weights; V200 unchanged. No pretrained or environment-trained weights. Freeze all parameters during checks and actual episodes.

generic_interface.description: Normalized numerical observations, stable candidate descriptors, actual successors, terminal flag, factual outcomes and known masks. No task identity or hidden table passed to model.

fixed_program.prior: independent Uniform[0,1] outcome prior of mass one
fixed_program.exploration: 0.5 epistemic proxy + 0.1 unsupported mass, plus 0.1 epsilon during discovery only
fixed_program.actual_trial_gate: n >= 8 and paired actual mean difference - 2 * sample standard error > 0; finite engineering heuristic, NOT a calibrated 95% CI

contract.chronology: Real discovery -> freeze candidate/incumbent -> real paired trials -> adoption verdict from actual outcomes only -> add completed trials to future working memory -> heldout evaluation not remembered. No imagined outcome becomes a memory fact.
contract.costs: All four controls receive identical actual discovery/trial/evaluation episode budgets and fixed episode lengths. No-gate still pays all trials. No-successor uses the same V202 weights. V200 is original untrained weight-programmed baseline, not a trained pure-RL baseline.
contract.evaluation: Report all eight seeds, first/last four cycles, whole 64 heldout evaluation episodes per run, post-reversal early window, adoption counts, exact interactions. Equal exogenous tapes for paired policies and controls; different trajectories remain actual execution.
contract.checks: 12 synthetic algebra/interface checks, counted separately from actual task episodes; no result-dependent rewriting.
claim_limits: finite fully observed numerical tasks only
no general semantic encoder or arbitrary-feature relevance learning
observed-successor planning is not proof of causality
sample mass proxy is not independent sample size
not the historical four reward/penalty training groups
contract.preservation: Exclusive new namespace/evidence; first failure or partial preserved; no automatic retry; no edits of executed source bytes; no old test fixture or result matrix rerun. New runtime use of unchanged V200 model on new tasks is declared.
contract.adoption: Standalone candidate checkpoint only; not installed into prior game models and no automation.
